segments.text: Five French sentences that sound innocent... but will make a French person choke on their croissant.
Number one. You want jam with no preservatives, so you say:
Congratulations. You just asked for jam... without condoms.
Number two. You're full after dinner, so you say:
That means you're pregnant... like a cow.
Number three. It's hot outside, so you say:
You just told everyone you're... in the mood.
Number four. You introduce your boss, and you say:
In French, introduire means to insert. Please... don't.
Number five. You finished your work, so you say:
That means your life is over. You're done for.
Which one have you already said? Tell me in the comments, and follow for part two.
